title: Quick Crispy Egyptian Parma Ham Fried Rice
description: A kid-friendly Egyptian dish featuring parma ham and crispy fried rice, low in calories and full of earthy flavors. This recipe is easy to make and fun to eat.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced parma ham and cook until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove the parma ham from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir-fry the rice mixture for about 5 minutes, or until the rice is heated through and starting to brown.
Return the crispy parma ham to the skillet and stir to combine with the rice mixture.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions.
